proposedOperatorData.name: Activity Pembrokeshire
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Coasteering, sea kayaking and outdoor adventures based at Stackpole Quay in South Pembrokeshire
proposedOperatorData.description:
Activity Pembrokeshire is a small adventure activity provider based at Stackpole Quay near Pembroke, operating in South Pembrokeshire since 2015. They run coasteering, sea kayaking, paddle boarding and rock climbing sessions along the coastline around Stackpole, Tenby, Saundersfoot, and the wider south Pembrokeshire area, aimed at beginners through to experienced adventurers, individuals, families and groups.

All equipment (wetsuits, buoyancy aids, helmets) is provided and sessions are led by qualified instructors. The business operates exclusively in South Pembrokeshire — it has no presence or activity offering in any other Welsh region.
